samples.scenario: Spear phishing email sent to legal department containing a PDF with embedded JavaScript redirecting to a credential harvesting site mimicking DocuSign
samples.technical_data: [Complex structure with keys: email_headers, smtp_transaction_log, pdf_embedded_js, domain_registration, url_reputation, web_server_logs]
samples.detection_method: Email gateway flagged SPF and DKIM failures indicating spoofed sender. PDF analysis revealed malicious JavaScript redirect.
